ordered_diagnoses: Necrotizing fasciitis of the buccal space

facts.raw_span: a two-week history of an asymptomatic swelling in the right lower half of the face
reduced mouth opening
two prior similar episodes over eight years
no pain or fever
a known diabetic on regular medication
gross right facial asymmetry
a 6 × 6 cm ovoid subcutaneous swelling
the borders were ill-defined, the consistency ranged from soft to firm
no lymphadenopathy, paresthesia, or facial palsy
Contrast-enhanced CT of the face showed a well-defined soft-tissue mass with cystic areas in the right buccal space
Intracystic loculations with dense cystic content were noted, and there was erosion of the posterior buccal cortex without perforation of the maxilla
a clinical diagnosis of a nonspecific chronic abscess with buccal-space involvement
